title: Dino Girl SVG
author: Happy Letters
fullDescription:
Dino Girl is scandinavian vector and rastr design elements and calligraphic quotes to help you create cute baby girl greeting cards, poster, wonderful children invitations, kids dashboards and stickers, prints for clothes fabric. It`s includes of Calligraphy quotes, seamless patterns, illustration elements, design posters, logo and other.
All in EPS, AI, DXF, SVG and PNG files (with transparency).
It’s a vector collection, so you can change the color, size and add different elements to your design so easily!

Kids Dino Girl set elements is collection bundle of phrases and decorations that will create funny children feeling in greeting cards and baby photo overlays for your friends and relatives or social media. Perfect for creating beautiful children’s clothing, nursery prints, birthday invites, baby shower invites, wall decor, t-shirts, crafts, products for kids and room decor.

Child quotes set includes some handwritten phrases: Beauty Saur, Dino Girl, Princess Dino, Pretty Saurus, Hello Dino, Cool Dino, It’s a Girl, Roar, Little cool Dino, Wild and Free, Little Dino, Dinoland, Super Dino, Dino Saur, Be Dino, Dino Party, My Little Dino, Be Wild, Let’s Roar, Funny Dino, Best Friends.

This bundle includes next illustration cliparts: rainbow, branch, leaf, palm, cactus, star, heart, branch, flower, leaf, cloud, abstract elements.

The product is intended for the user with a minimum knowledge of Photoshop or Illustrator. You can use this product svg files also on Canva.

WHAT’S INCLUDED

24 Dinos (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG);
16 Dino seamless patterns (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG);
35 Dino phrases (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG);
35 Dino elements (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG);
07 Dino compositions (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG);
08 Dino frames (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG);
09 Dino greeting cards (EPS, DXF, AI, SVG, PNG).

You will get 133 lettering & clipart elements in total.

PLEASE NOTE

Calligraphy quotes (eg text) is not editable! Those quotes and words are not fonts, but drawings of the letters, so you won’t be able to change it to your text, you can only use it as it is.

You will get files in PNG, EPS, AI, DXF, SVG. Vector files EPS and AI are saved in EPS10 version and PNG has transparent background, each element is saved separately
